origin: NGP45H factory boot chain; TF and eMMC copies were byte-identical for DDR/SPL and FIT
other_rk3562_models: Cross-model compatibility not established; factory-bootloader synchronization must be excluded during validation.

bootloader_area.remaining_bytes: zero-filled; no partition table or device-specific Vendor Storage

generation.idb: Place the two 512 KiB IDB slots from a working NGP45H disk at their original LBA 64 and 1088 in an otherwise zero-filled 8 MiB area.
generation.fit: Change only bootcmd in the original NGP45H FIT environment to new_bootcmd, update the uboot component SHA-256, and mirror the first 2 MiB into the second copy. Verify every component hash in both copies.

validation_notes.Xifan NGP45H: TF-first FIT was written and verified before the successful boot test.
validation_notes.AISLPC RG43H Pro: The same system card booted, but subsequent live inspection found its TF DDR/SPL and FIT identical to its own stock eMMC, with bootcmd unchanged. This does not establish that NGP45H TF-first boot code is compatible with RG43H Pro.

runtime_update_policy.new_images: Use the bundled NGP45H TF-first boot chain as the default initial bootloader.
runtime_update_policy.first_boot_and_system_updates: Sync the device-specific stock DDR/SPL and U-Boot FIT from eMMC together with its factory DTB and boot assets. Do not mix a retained U-Boot with assets meant for a different hardcoded DTB filename.
runtime_update_policy.bootcmd_after_sync: Restored from the device eMMC unchanged; the bundled TF-first bootcmd is not preserved by this stock sync.
